recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future ballot-intro page reintroduces a normative package/material list whose heading again suggests resource-only scope.
issue_request: FHIR-17003 was a Published FHIR-core/FHIR-I change request from the 2018-May ballot intro page, resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked to rename the section headed "Normative Ballot Packages" to "Normative Ballot Material" because the heading could imply that only resources, rather than all normative pages/material, were listed; the recorded resolution was to rename and clarify.
initial_application: No source commit mentioning FHIR-17003 was found. The Jira comment says it was "fixed earlier by restructuing the page." Git history shows the old heading was introduced in source/ballot-intro.html in 2017, and later ballot-intro restructures removed the old R4 normative-package section entirely before the current R6 ballot-intro source.
additional_context: source/ballot-intro.html is in current build scope as an active [pages] entry in publish.ini. The current source is an R6 ballot roadmap with sections for ballot process, ballot scope, and details of changes; it does not contain either the misleading "Normative Ballot Packages" heading or the proposed historical replacement. FHIR-17003 phrase searches found no related Jira issue beyond the seed and no directly relevant Zulip or Confluence record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source no longer contains the misleading 2018 heading or the old normative-package list, so applying the historical rename would be obsolete and adding parallel explanatory prose would not improve the current built specification.
